files.name: motion-prompt-106.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Tilt-shift" (ティルトシフト), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #106

What it is: Blur top and bottom so a real scene looks like a miniature
What the sample shows: The top and bottom bands of the street blur while only the middle band with the road, the car and the small people stays in focus, so the street looks like a model.
Spec:
- The street corner (buildings, trees and lamps behind a road at y 132–162) without the large person; four small people 23–26 px tall stand on the pavement (feet at y 172); the car drives from x −60 to 600 every 5 s
- Focus band: y 66–176 stays sharp
- Blur: y 0–42 and y 190–208 go 0 → 7 px; y 42–66 and y 176–190 go 0 → 3 px
- Dashed lines on the band edges (6 px dash, 5 px gap, #8E8E93 at 75%)
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: To make a city or event look like a toy model world.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/106.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
